w3Mentions.name: The Redactor
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something pads into the clearing — The Redactor. It's here.

w3Mentions.firstLine: Back at the haven the argument starts: Giuseppe is calling it "Old Gavel." They'll fight it out — weigh in if you want.

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: It's settled. The village is calling it "Ugly-Eyes." The Codex keeps it.
◈ The System files the name away with visible satisfaction. It has so few words for things that bleed. (+2 integration)
📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
⚠ WARNING: reserves critical. Eat tomorrow or the spiral begins.
You camp wild tonight — no pantry meal. Eat from your pack.

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — regional standing, waves 1–3 faced (22/12/6), with 6 wave-4 fought, 16 contests survived, 3 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices.
noticeLines: ◈ THE SYSTEM — "NOTICED. YOUR REGISTER IS SHIFTING TOTAL — COLD, CLEAN, EFFICIENT. YOU WOULD MAKE A MAGNIFICENT MACHINE. I MEAN THAT AS THE HIGHEST COMPLIMENT AND SLIGHTLY AS A THREAT."
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. More promises broken than kept; the protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared; the relay carried faithfully. The dark road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ Giuseppe Barbieri reached into the light and the light reached back — person and machine, two caretakers, holding the channel open between them both ways. The village endures, and the conversation does not end.

gotAwayLines: It got away. No meat, no trophy — but you're breathing, and now you know its moves.
